name: B4·2 Customer Care Brain — AI triage + FAQ auto-answer + angry-customer escalation (3 automations combined)

parameters.content:
## ⚙️ SETUP — step by step
1. Variables: **GEMINI_API_KEY, TG_OWNER_CHAT_ID, BRAND_NAME, FAQ_TEXT** (paste your policies into FAQ_TEXT: timings, address, exchange policy, making charges, scheme rules, repair time…).
2. Attach Telegram + Sheets credentials. Tab **CareLog** (Time, Channel, From, Message, Intent, Sentiment, Reply, Escalated).
3. Point ANY channel at the `care-in` webhook (POST {channel, from, name, message}):
   • ManyChat: External Request action (IG/FB DMs)
   • WhatsApp: from workflow #2's webhook via an HTTP node
   • Website chat / Telegram bot: same shape.

## HOW IT RUNS
Every incoming message → Gemini classifies intent (price / order status / repair / complaint / visit / other) + sentiment, drafts a reply grounded ONLY in your FAQ_TEXT →
• normal → reply text returned to the channel (webhook response) + logged.
• ANGRY or complaint → 🔴 instant owner escalation with suggested apology; no auto-reply so a human takes over.

## 🔧 FIX
• Wrong answers → improve FAQ_TEXT; the AI is instructed to say 'let me connect you to the owner' when unsure.
• Every msg escalating → sentiment threshold in 'Route' (change <= -0.3).

parameters.jsonBody: ={ "contents": [{ "parts": [{ "text": "You are the friendly customer-care assistant of {{$env.BRAND_NAME}}, an Indian gold jewellery showroom. Store facts you MUST use (do not invent anything else): {{ JSON.stringify($env.FAQ_TEXT||'') }}. Customer message: {{ JSON.stringify($json.body.message||'') }}. Return STRICT JSON only: {intent: one of price|order|repair|complaint|visit|other, sentiment: -1 to 1, reply: a warm 1-3 line answer (if unsure say you will connect them to the owner)}" }] }] }

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ reply: $json.escalate ? 'Namaste! So sorry to hear this — the owner has been alerted personally and will contact you right away. 🙏' : $json.Reply }) }}
